mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 27 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park and a full moon.

City offices will close November 26 and 27 for the holiday, so please note that refuse and recycling pickup is delayed to Friday. Additionally, there is a public meeting regarding the Military Ridge State Trail paving project on December 8.
We have a busy couple of days with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee all taking place today.
In a noteworthy call from November 4, a driver was arrested for O W I in a business parking lot while having a child passenger in the vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Dark Chocolate Decadence, and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
